# openai_project_model_permissions (Resource)

Updates model access permissions for a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_project_model_permissions" "example" {
  project_id = "proj_000000000000000000000000"
  mode       = "allow_list"
  model_ids  = ["gpt-4.1", "o3"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) The model permissions mode to apply. One of `allow_list` or `deny_list`.
- `model_ids` (Set of String) The model IDs included in this permissions policy.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project for which model permissions are being set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing project model permissions
terraform import openai_project_model_permissions.example <project_id>

# Example
terraform import openai_project_model_permissions.example proj_000000000000000000000000
```
